Source.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/11] They included self- and parentreport questionnaires plus clinician-rated measures. All of the assessments were administered to both groups by independent evaluators unaware of the participants` treatment condition. These evaluators had bachelor`s degrees in psychology and were trained in the assessments (CGAS and K-SADS) before the study.
